subject: crossfit junkies
one_liner: A video platform for people whose last rep requires independent witnesses.
brand_voice_notes: Dry sports-platform administration. Treat camera coverage, subscriptions and rep disputes as serious infrastructure. No wink, hype or fitness promises. Apply local anti-ai-slop scan to all visible copy.

hero.h1: Your last rep needs an audience.
hero.sub: Upload the set. Chapter every rep. Let strangers with lifting straps decide whether it happened. Again is the video platform for crossfit junkies who need the footage to count.

features.title: A chapter for every rep.
features.blurb: Our AI gives each repetition its own timestamp, title and retention curve. Rep seven has a small but committed following.

features.title: No-rep moderation.
features.blurb: Nine accepted. Three outside the frame. Each ruling comes with a timestamp and a comments section with no cooling-off period.

features.title: Autoplay the consequences.
features.blurb: Finish a set and the next one queues itself. Rest days remain available through a separate cancellation process.

demo_screen_concept: One video-review watch page for Twelve wall balls, one camera. A simulated 60-second review player has play/pause, seek and chapter selection. Twelve rep buttons jump to five-second chapters; nine initially accepted and reps 4, 8 and 12 outside frame. A judge panel changes the selected verdict between accepted and no rep, updating live counts and filtered chapter list. Subscription toggle and a local timestamped comment form complete the watch-page mechanics. Clearly labeled simulated review with no real video or API.

design_direction.style: Athletic equipment catalogue: bright pool-blue open canvas, giant condensed sloped type, cobalt structural bands and orange review cues. Broad centered opening and full-width airbrushed equipment artwork; no dark gym aesthetic.

palette.name: Pool Blue, Cobalt and Safety Orange

design_direction.archetype: Video-First Hero from bundled ui-ux-pro-max landing library, adapted to a composed equipment poster and live HTML CTA. Product mechanics, large data-story composition, testimonial strip and membership plans follow.
design_direction.motion_vocab: 160ms control color transitions. Playback moves the playhead only after user action. Reduced motion disables CSS transitions. No ambient loops.
design_direction.hero_composition_notes: Centered oversized condensed headline over a shallow pool-blue opening, slim centered support copy and primary CTA. Full-width 16:9 campaign under the opening becomes the memorable object. Open feature rows alternate title and explanatory prose. Infographic receives a broad dedicated white field with separate live stats. Demo is a watch page with a dominant simulation and rep inspector, not a landing-page clone.
design_direction.design_review: Read latest seven concepts and identity records. Library recommends vibrant blocks, video-first and Space Grotesk. Retain video-first, replace dark pink default and recently used Space Grotesk with library Sports/Fitness pair and pool-blue equipment catalogue. No matching tuple. Strapped replay symbol and airbrushed sculptural equipment differ from huddle contours, selected seeds, parcel tabs, lightsticks, cinema programmes, timing lime and intern noticeboard. Boldness concentrated in campaign object and condensed hero. No numbered features or decorative eyebrow labels.

brand_kit.identity_rationale: YouTube replay and rep review meet the loop of a lifting strap. Gemini will design an original strapped return symbol and Again wordmark. The equipment illustration and chapter notches translate viewing into a physical training object without copying the YouTube play-button trademark.

logo.concept: Accepted Gemini direction A: woven cobalt lifting strap returning into a compact loop with orange folded tip, beside bespoke italic Again lettering. B rejected: offset collar bracket is clear but generic and less tied to repeated viewing.
logo.clear_space: At least half the symbol height on all sides, included in image padding and placement spacing.
logo.placement: Landing navigation and footer; demo chrome; cropped accepted symbol as favicon on both pages
logo.review: Visually compared both Gemini directions; selected A. Inspected accepted alpha knockout and cobalt mono on actual #E5F1FA at 300px and 160px lockup widths, symbol at 32px and 64px. Exact Again spelling; open loop and orange end remain visible. No checkerboard or approximate redraw.

graphic_language.medium: Airbrushed sculptural sports-equipment illustration with oversized condensed typography and precise chapter annotations. Cobalt, pool blue, orange and white.
graphic_language.motif: A lifting strap returns into a replay loop; chapter notches used at actual rep boundaries.
graphic_language.composition: One large sculptural object per artwork; strong asymmetric typographic hierarchy with broad clear margins. Preserve full compositions with contain sizing.
graphic_language.texture: Soft airbrush shading and fine rubber grain inside artwork only; flat CSS surfaces.

tokens.borders: 1px solid var(--line); 2px solid var(--primary) for selected chapters

graphic_plan.purpose: A typographic equipment campaign making recorded effort into a heavy physical object.
Designed rep-review data story: 12 filmed, 9 accepted, 3 outside frame; rejected reps 4, 8 and 12.

images.rationale: Five successful Gemini calls: logo A and B, then campaign and infographic using accepted A as actual image reference, then one matching demo illustration. Two composed graphics and logo were completed before optional demo imagery. No photographs needed. Faithful mono and icon exports consume zero generation calls. All full compositions retained under 500 KB.

items.prompt: Design a finished original logo for the fictional video platform Again, YouTube for crossfit junkies. Product mechanics: replay, rep chapters, witnessed movement. Exact wordmark text: "Again" with capital A, lowercase gain, no other text. A bespoke confident slightly forward-leaning condensed sans wordmark, clean readable lettering. Direction A: a thick woven lifting strap loops back around itself into a compact return/replay symbol with an open central gap; the strap should feel load-bearing, with a small orange folded end. Original silhouette, no play triangle, no YouTube mark, no rounded-square badge, no stock dumbbell. Symbol on left, Again on right, centered horizontal lockup with generous clear space. Flat cobalt #214DA6 and orange #F25536 ink on perfectly flat pale pool-blue #E5F1FA background. Flat vector-like actual production logo only, no mockup, no board, no texture, no gradients, no shadow, no extra text. Design for legibility at navigation scale and a clear 32px symbol.
items.placement: Landing nav and footer; demo chrome
items.verdict: Accepted: exact Again spelling, controlled slant and spacing, physical strap motif; broad open center and orange tab survive icon reduction.
items.transformation: Faithful background knockout, clear-space crop and WebP encoding from accepted candidate A. No creative redrawing.
Recolor accepted alpha silhouette cobalt #214DA6; no change to geometry.
items.placement: Monochrome reserve; icon used as favicon on both pages
items.verdict: Accepted after visual review: original geometry preserved; cobalt mono readable on pool blue; icon center and orange tab visible at 32px and 64px.

items.transformation: Crop original accepted strap symbol only, pad square and resize to 128px.
items.verdict: Accepted after visual review: original geometry preserved; cobalt mono readable on pool blue; icon center and orange tab visible at 32px and 64px.

items.prompt: Create a finished 16:9 graphic-design campaign artwork for Again. Attached image is the APPROVED IDENTITY REFERENCE: preserve its Again lettering and looped woven lifting strap with orange tab. This is designed editorial artwork, not a photograph or a website screenshot. Art direction: pale pool blue #E5F1FA, cobalt #214DA6, orange #F25536 and white; airbrushed sculptural sports-equipment illustration, crisp oversized condensed oblique typography. Compose a gigantic cobalt weight plate whose center hole is threaded by the approved woven replay strap, the orange end curling toward viewer. Along its rim, 12 substantial chapter notches suggest a video timeline, with a small orange playhead at one notch. Sculptural perspective, beautiful rubber grain and disciplined airbrush light, original industrial sports editorial aesthetic. Place the object dramatically on the right two thirds, and compose the exact headline "Proof of work." in giant cobalt condensed italic letters on left across two lines. Small approved Again logo at lower left with clear space. Only allowed text: "Proof of work." and "Again". No other copy, no gibberish, no watermark, no photography, no simple diagram. Plenty of negative space, safe margins 7 percent. The entire designed composition must read on mobile. No UI controls. Design type, object, graphic structure and hierarchy together.
items.verdict: Accepted: Proof of work. and Again are correctly spelled. Integrated giant type, sculptural weight plate and woven strap form a designed campaign; controlled blue and orange; full composition retained. Mobile-scale review pending. Visually inspected at full desktop and 375px mobile widths: embedded type and chapter numbers readable; live HTML repeats all essential copy and quantities.
items.transformation: Full composition encoded to WebP; no cover crop.

items.prompt: Create a finished 4:3 designed infographic / data-story composition for Again. Attached image is the APPROVED IDENTITY REFERENCE; preserve the Again letterforms, cobalt lifting-strap loop and orange folded tip. Explain a fictional video review: 12 filmed repetitions, 9 accepted, 3 outside the camera frame. Rejected rep numbers are exactly 4, 8 and 12. Design an ambitious airbrushed sports editorial composition in cobalt #214DA6, orange #F25536, pool blue #E5F1FA and white. Main hierarchy: a huge cobalt 12 at upper left with exact label "filmed"; a substantial illustrated woven strap sweeps in a broad arc around a bank of twelve sculptural numbered chapter tabs, ordered 1 to 12 in three rows of four. Tabs 4, 8 and 12 are orange and lifted out of alignment; remaining nine cobalt. At bottom, giant "9 accepted" and "3 outside frame" in clear condensed sans, with strong negative space. This is an information-designed poster with illustrated equipment and integrated typography, not a plain bar chart, basic arrow diagram, photo or rendered website. Include small approved Again wordmark. Only text allowed: "12", "filmed", the chapter numbers "1" through "12", "9 accepted", "3 outside frame", "Again". Use exact counts. No extra words, no gibberish or watermark. Full safe margins, readable large typography, preserve full composition.
items.verdict: Accepted: all twelve numbered tabs appear exactly once in order, 4/8/12 orange, nine cobalt. Exact 12 filmed, 9 accepted, 3 outside frame. Strap and wordmark match reference. Full data-story composition retained, not a photo or basic diagram. Visually inspected at full desktop and 375px mobile widths: embedded type and chapter numbers readable; live HTML repeats all essential copy and quantities.
items.transformation: Full composition encoded to WebP without cropping.

items.prompt: Illustration for a simulated video review on Again, the video platform for crossfit junkies. Attached first image is APPROVED IDENTITY REFERENCE; second is APPROVED MEDIUM AND STYLE REFERENCE. No text or logos are to appear in this image. Make an airbrushed editorial sports illustration matching the reference: cobalt #214DA6 sculptural faceless human athlete in simple plain athletic clothes, orange #F25536 medicine ball just released above their raised hands toward a tall pale pool-blue #E5F1FA gym wall. Full human figure, feet planted, clearly a wall-ball exercise with arms raised. Three-quarter side angle. Large architectural shadow, smooth rubber-like material, bright restrained palette, highly designed studio composition, no photography, no UI, no labels, no numbers, no watermark, no bodybuilder caricature. Athlete centered-right with empty upper left for live HTML overlay. Broad landscape 16:9 frame. No brand logos on clothing or equipment. Subject is fictional.
items.verdict: Accepted: original sculptural cobalt athlete with raised hands and orange ball in a bright gym; no unwanted text or logos, consistent airbrushed equipment medium. Explicitly presented as an illustrated simulation, not real video.
items.transformation: Full landscape composition encoded WebP without cropping.

discarded.prompt: Design a finished original logo for Again, a fictional video platform for crossfit junkies who require witnesses for every rep. Exact wordmark text: "Again". Direction B must differ from a woven loop: a single bent barbell collar becomes an open return bracket with a second offset grip notch, expressing repetition and a video chapter boundary. Invent a compact distinctive athletic glyph, not a stock weight, not a play triangle, not a square badge. Pair it on the left with bespoke forward-leaning condensed Again lettering, very legible. Flat cobalt #214DA6 and orange #F25536 on perfectly flat pool blue #E5F1FA. Horizontal symbol plus wordmark centered with generous clear space. Actual logo artwork only, no board, no application mockup, no shadows, no texture, no extra text. Keep all five letters exact and evenly spaced.
discarded.verdict: Rejected direction B: bracket silhouette reads as generic crop or sync mark; strap A makes the specific product behavior more legible. Both spell Again correctly.
